node.title: HGE4 primitive swap half-order square descent
node.statement: For odd h=2d+1, squaring the roots bijects primitive antipodal-swap near-square unions with h-subsets Y of mu_(n/2) having trivial scaling stabilizer and locator L_Y satisfying (L_Y+c_Y)/Z=T_Y^2, where c_Y=prod(Y). Equivalently L_Y=ZT_Y^2-c_Y divides Z^(n/2)-1. Scaling orbits correspond through mu_n/{+/-1}=mu_(n/2), so V_h^swap=W_h and A_h^swap=hW_h. An anchored generator performs one deterministic perfect-square test on each of binom(n/2-1,h-1) supports and removes all 2^(h-1) sign choices. No survivor bound or free-union bound is claimed.
